subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: The manager said to the employee, "Do you believe that team work enhances productivity?" "Yes sir, I believe so," the employee replied. "Then you must collaborate effectively with your collegues," said the manager. "Thank you, sir," said the employee "May you succeed in your career," the manager said.
guide_solution: The manager asked the employee if he (e) believed that team work enhances productivity. The employee respectfully replied in the affirmative and said that he (e) believed so. At this the manger said that he (e) had to collaborate effectively with his (e) colleagues. The employee thanked the manager politely. The manager prayed that the (e) might succeed in his (e) career.
